facts.fact: Finlay 走后的两个星期：音讯全无，她连出门的力气都没有。
facts.anchor: It’s been two excruciating weeks since Finlay Munro walked through my door

facts.fact: 连那个「她」——不知是谁的女人——也消失了，Cassie 觉得自己彻底无用。
facts.anchor: Even she – whoever she was – has gone, too, rendering me one-hundred per cent useless.

facts.fact: Natters with Nova？更像一颗超新星——一颗垂死爆炸的星。
facts.anchor: More like a supernova. A poor star on its last legs, exploding, dying.

facts.fact: 猫 Luna 的指甲在无毯地板上哒哒作响，像踩着高跟鞋；她是被前任主人丢弃的。
facts.anchor: nails clip-clopping against the uncarpeted floorboards, as if she’s wearing a pair of high heels.

facts.fact: Luna 的爱真实而滚烫——很可能是她撑到今天的原因。
facts.anchor: The feeling is genuine, raw, heart-wrenching, and probably the only thing that’s kept me here for this long.

facts.fact: 麻木时她想象自己被海浪卷走、冲刷干净——最危险的念头。
facts.anchor: the ocean in the distance is really where I long to be, swept up, and washed away.

facts.fact: 这套公寓的来历可疑：网上联系房东、没见过面、花盆下的钥匙、门阶信封里的合同。
facts.anchor: a key was left for me under one of the plant pots along with a contract.

facts.fact: 章尾：手机上跳出一条意外的私信申请。
facts.anchor: I have an unexpected notification. One new message request.
